page.layout: Running head "EMBLEMA" at top centre with page number 146 at top left; below it a full-width title in capitals with a subtitle line in italic; then a woodcut emblem (engraving of a skeleton and a man digging at a tree above a hill, with naked figures in flames at right) occupying the centre; below the picture four lines of italic verse in the centre; a catchword-like word "FVRVM" at the lower right, as a marginal/side tag under the verse. No text columns, no margin notes.

p.i: Vt si quem videas fodiendis lege metallis, Damnatum, vano se macerare labore: Sic auro quisquis studet, argentoq; parandis, Deserit, & Stygias fors vehitur sub aquas!

page.notes: The woodcut (emblem picture) is not transcribed. The motto line "Vt si quem videas..." is printed with the first line set in italic; the word after "labore" in line 2 is printed as "labore" with a small mark, read as uncertain. The word at lower right, "FVRVM", is set in small capitals and may be a catchword or signature; it is placed as a footer element. Line 2 "Damnatum" and line 4 "fors" read as printed. Some letters in the title are damaged, notably "AVFER" and "relinquendum est".
